scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w dropbyte-backend" "npm run dev -w dropbyte-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w dropbyte-backend && npm run build -w dropbyte-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start -w dropbyte-backend" "npm run preview -w dropbyte-frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w dropbyte-backend && npm run typecheck -w dropbyte-frontend
